_comment: TODO: fill in real bus/slave_id/register values - these sensor_ids match seed/seed.py's SENSORS list and the `sensors` table, but the wiring fields below (bus, slave_id, register) are placeholders and MUST be replaced from each Modbus device's datasheet/DIP-switch config before use. bus is /dev/ttyUSB0 or /dev/ttyUSB1 per the two RS-485 adapters. See edge/mockgen.py ModbusRegisterMap for field meanings.
_comment_scope: Only sensors with interface='modbus' in the `sensors` table belong in this file - the 15 DS18B20 probes (interface='onewire') and PMS7003 PM channels (interface='pms7003') live in edge/onewire_map.json and edge/pms7003_map.json instead. Do not duplicate them here: CompositeSensorSource (edge/mockgen.py) requires each sensor_id be claimed by exactly one map/poller and raises at startup if two claim the same id.
_comment_relay_module: TODO: the 12V Modbus relay module (damper + solenoid control, per the BOM) is not represented in seed/seed.py's SENSORS list or here yet. It's unclear whether it exposes Modbus-readable status/feedback registers (vs. write-only coils with no readback) - confirm from its datasheet, then add sensor_id(s) to seed/seed.py with interface='modbus' and a matching entry here. Do not invent register numbers or tag names before that's confirmed - a fabricated placeholder here would be silently 'plausible' in a way a real safety-relevant device (damper interlock) shouldn't be.
_comment_o2: The ASAIR AO-03 O2 sensor's own datasheet (aosong.com) confirms it is a raw analog current output (0.1mA in air, linear 1-25% Vol O2 across a 100 ohm load resistor) - NOT a digital interface. It reads through a channel of the Waveshare 8-channel analog module on the RS-485 bus, which is itself the Modbus slave - hence interface='modbus' in seed/seed.py even though the O2 cell itself has no protocol. slave_id/register below are STILL placeholders: they need the Waveshare module's own register map (separate datasheet, not yet available) to know which holding register that analog channel lands on.
